description: Use this when the user asks how a group's shared expenses stand: who owes whom, how much someone owes or is owed, how to settle up or what has been spent lately. Shows one apaxas group: what each person owes or is owed, the payments that would even everyone up and the latest expenses.

gastos.description: How many of the latest expenses to include (30 if not given).

grupo.description: The group's code, the end of its link. Its name or its link also work.

llave.description: The key that came with this group when it was created without an apaxas account. Not needed when the user's account is connected.

name: ver_grupo
title: Ver un grupo
